# Test fixtures

`fixtures/noted-exercise.pdf` is an original synthetic score-like PDF created
for this repository and dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. Its
generator sources are in `fixtures/generate/`.

The fixture contains no uploaded user score and is safe for unit and browser
tests. Runtime uploads belong only under the gitignored `.local/` directory.

`fixtures/noted-valid-ccitt.pdf` is a corrected single-strip encoding of the original CC0
fixture artwork. `tools/score-intake-proof/generate-ccitt.py` generates the corresponding
`.local/score-intake-proof/valid-ccitt-original.pdf`; the committed copy uses the
`fixtures/noted-valid-ccitt.pdf` name. The
older `fixtures/noted-ccitt-exercise.pdf` remains a deliberately recognized malformed
baseline: its generator concatenates independent TIFF strips. The new parser
rejects that incomplete stream; acceptance tests use the valid fixture.

`fixtures/noted-photo-exif-6.jpg` and `fixtures/noted-photo-exif-8.jpg` are JPEG versions of the same
original CC0 artwork with EXIF orientations 6 and 8. They verify that image
preview and worker export use the displayed orientation, rather than the raw
JPEG dimensions. No uploaded user music or external edition is included.

`fixtures/noted-photo-20mp.jpg` is original CC0 artwork generated by
`fixtures/generate/high-resolution-photo.py` (Pillow). Its 4000×5000 pixels include
thin staff lines, dots, faint gray pencil strokes and a color mark. It tests the
bounded photo-correction working resolution and unchanged JPEG passthrough.

With the local API and web app running, `scripts/verify-photo-preview.sh` uses this
fixture in a temporary Chromium session. It compares the fast raster preview with
the final worker PDF and checks geometry, page order, paper cleanup, staff marks,
faint pencil strokes and the color mark. Its two-page build also combines a cached
page whose source cannot be fetched with an uncached photo, proving partial cache
reuse and output order. The script installs its browser driver in a temporary
directory and deletes its draft and temporary files when it exits.
